the Twitter users posting suicidal content are more connected with each other than with other users, and that there are users that are more connected to the suicidal users than others.

1) users who post suicidal content on Twitter are highly connected with each other, and 2) the retweets of their content connect them with users who were neither the authors nor retweeters of the suicidal Tweets, thus creating a bridge between the two sets.
